content: He who has conquered his own mind has conquered the world. He who is a slave to his mind remains a beggar in royal robes.
author: Kabir
explanation: Outer empire and wealth cannot remedy internal turbulence. True sovereignty is mastery over one's runaway desires, reactive impulses, and psychological fears.
practicalInsight: When an impulsive craving or anger arises today, do not obey it immediately. Stand as the master of your awareness and let the impulse dissolve.
reflectionPrompt: Am I ruling my mind, or is my mind dragging me around by my cravings?
